entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • In Blazor Nullable<TimeSpan> generates error "The value '' is not valid for 'Property'." when value is empty #66607
  • Inconsistent handling of traceId serializing when using non camelCase json serialization #66603
    Backlog
  • DefaultProblemDetailsWriter doesn't pass cancellation token to WriteAsJsonAsync #66600
    11.0-preview5
  • Error FilterStaticWebAssetEndpoints on build after updating to net10 (CSS?) #66599
  • PAR (pushed authorization requests) are not retried #66598
  • Unable to find package `Microsoft.Extensions.ServiceDiscovery` with version (>= 10.6.0-preview.1.26210.2) after creating blazor-wasm-servicedefaults project #66594
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #66592
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #66591

Closed

  • Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2026-26130 – .NET Denial of Service Vulnerability #65727
  • Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2023-44487: .NET Denial of Service Vulnerability #51264
    Backlog
  • [NETSDKE2E] 'System.InvalidOperationException: Unable to configure HTTPS endpoint' error occurred when running web projects with SDK 10.0.102 and 10.0.200 preview both installed. #65016
  • I can't launch debug after migration from VS 2022 to VS 2026. "Filed to launch debug adapter" #65689
  • ValidationEndpointFilterFactory returns problem details without a status set. #66601
  • Issue Triage Agent for dotnet/aspnetcore doesn't know what the current .net version is #66476

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #66610
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • Pass RequestAborted cancellation token to WriteAsJsonAsync in DefaultProblemDetailsWriter #66606
    area-networking
  • Fix WindowsCertificateManager to correctly detect user cancellation of trust dialog #66604
    needs-area-label

Merged

  • Minor fixes and updates in agentic-workflows #66597
    area-infrastructure, 11.0-preview5
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #66593
    area-infrastructure, 11.0-preview5
  • Close quarantine issues via PR merge instead of manually #66605
    area-infrastructure, 11.0-preview5
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #66595
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, 10.0.9
  • Ensure HttpValidationProblemDetails status is set to 400 (BadRequest) #66602
    area-networking, 11.0-preview5

Updated

  • Fix missing APIs in source-build builds and enabled public api analyzer to catch regressions #66588
    area-networking
  • Update Composite ML-DSA OIDs to final IANA-assigned values #66576
    area-infrastructure
  • MVC+OpenAPI: Support multiple `Produces` for same status code / content-type #65650
    area-mvc, feature-openapi, pending-ci-rerun
  • Add special handling for array types in OpenAPI schema references. #66583
    feature-openapi, area-minimal
  • feat(blazor): add CssClass parameter to ValidationSummary component #66531
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Cache uncached AppContext.TryGetSwitch calls #66513
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview5
  • Let JsonException bubble through problem details in minimal APIs #66519
    area-minimal
  • [blazor] E2E test coreCLR WASM #66331
    area-blazor, .NET 11 Planning
  • Fix ValidationsGenerator ITypeParameterSymbol handling #65419
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-minimal, feature-validation
  • RenderFragment serialization #66528
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview5
  • feat: add missing [StringSyntax(DateTimeFormat)] to DateTimeOffset methods in BindConverter #66532
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Implement Cross-Site Request Forgery Algorithm based on Fetch Metadata headers #66585
    area-networking, feature-antiforgery
